description: Defines an immutable data model class 'AccountModel' for representing bank or wallet accounts, including properties for id, name, and balance, with a copyWith method for creating modified copies.

classes.name: AccountModel
classes.description: An immutable data class representing an account with id, name, and balance.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Returns a copy of the AccountModel with optional new values for id, name, and balance.
